notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: bank 'b' = rows f-j. In the image the upper half is labelled j-f, so it maps to bank 'b'.

Column numbers read from the image: orange wire at column 4 row g, resistor between columns 4 and 6 in row h, LED legs in columns 6 (anode, bent longer leg) and 8 (cathode) in row i, black wire at column 8 row h.
The black wire goes to the GND pin next to AREF on the Uno header, mapped to GND.1 (the catalogue does not say which GND that is).
The resistor is 220 ohm, as given in the manual and the schematic. The LED is red in the image.
The sketch and USB power are not modelled.
